audience.reader: The notebook owner, reading the run report and the served surface to decide what to hand over next.
audience.decision: Whether to provide the real Ideaflow export (owner input #1) and author the semantic acceptance cases (owner input #3), or to change the migration's structural decisions first.
priorBeliefs: The owner knows the ground truth was corrected mid-run: Mew is the local codebase, the 0B receipt is superseded, 3 acceptance cases are harvested but unevaluated, and zero database records exist anywhere in this pipeline.

surfaces.description: The locally served agent surface: store counts, the empty-store disclosure, and answers that render bound excerpts or an explicit UNBOUND state.
docs/MEW_MIGRATION_RUN_REPORT.md — the traversal report where these exact sentences are rendered to the owner.

disclosures.text: Not verified against any real export: no Ideaflow session exists and no export file has ever been read; the accepted shape comes from public documentation only.
No notebook data has been imported — the store is empty until the owner's Ideaflow export exists. Answers cannot cite what does not exist.

claims.statement: The importer refuses loudly and its manifest closes per table: every exported record is imported, refused with a reason, or in a counted, disclosed drop.
claims.boundary: Demonstrated on labeled fixture data only. It says nothing about how many records the owner's database holds or whether a real export would import cleanly — no real export has ever been read.

claims.statement: Every migrated row carries sourceId, sourceDigest and importedAt, and every table is enumerable for erasure by sourceId.
claims.boundary: A property of the schema and importer as built and unit-tested. The Convex tables themselves have never been created — the deploy is credential-gated — so this is enforced code, not an observed production database.

claims.statement: An answer with no source binding renders as UNBOUND; the agent surface has no generative fallback.
claims.boundary: Verified by unit tests and a raw-http probe of a locally served instance. No rendered-DOM observation exists, and nothing here claims one.

claims.statement: The surface discloses that no notebook data has been imported; the store it answers from holds zero graph nodes.
claims.boundary: A statement about this software's own empty store, not about the notebook. The database's contents and size remain unknown (awaiting owner input #1: one run of Mew's own exporter).

claims.statement: The importer accepts the exact JSON shape that Mew's own database exporter writes.

unbound.detail: The accepted shape is bound to the exporter and schema read from the owner's local personal-dev-mew checkout (digests in proof/mew-migration/local-recon.json), but no real export file has ever been produced or read, and schema drift across the owner's three branches is real and unresolved.
unbound.whatWouldBindIt: One real export file from `yarn tsx scripts/export-database.ts` in personal-dev-mew, imported with every table closing and zero drift refusals.
unbound.riskIfBelieved: If the owner's database was created from a different branch's schema, the first real import refuses the drifted records loudly; the reader would have expected a clean migration and gets a manifest full of drift refusals instead.

claims.boundary: A code-derived expectation, not a measurement against real bytes. The importer's strictness means a mismatch fails loudly rather than importing garbage, but loud failure is still failure.

withheldClaims.statement: The notebook has been migrated out of Ideaflow into a store the owner controls.
withheldClaims.detail: Zero records have ever been read from the owner's database (remote Postgres; credentials deliberately unused — local-recon receipt). There is no export, no inventory, and therefore no migration of anything real to claim.

withheldClaims.statement: All of the notebook's nodes, relations, relation types and list entries survived the migration intact.
withheldClaims.detail: The inventory (N nodes, M relations) is unknown and deliberately unestimated, awaiting owner input #1. A count claim with no denominator is the vacuous pass.

withheldClaims.statement: Asking the surface about a topic surfaces the note the owner wrote about it.
withheldClaims.detail: Zero owner nodes exist to surface, and the 3 harvested owner-authored cases (harness/mew-migration/notion-cases.json) exercise CRUD orchestration this retrieval-only slice does not implement. The semantic scorecard column is NOT_RUN with both reasons recorded per case.

claimed: Every rendered claim is bound to BuildEvidencePack evidence by evidenceId or carries an unbound record with adjacent disclosure copy; there is no third state in this pack.
Every statement was scanned against the committed regulated-phrase lexicon at the digest recorded in each phraseScan; zero matches surfaced on rendered claims.
Three claims about the owner's data were withheld with reasons rather than rendered or softened.
notRun: No claim about the owner's actual notebook was evaluated: zero notes and zero semantic cases exist anywhere in this pipeline.
No human has read this pack or its disclosure copy; nothing here asserts review.
The lexicon covers the named §W2 phrase families only; a novel misleading phrasing outside it would not be caught by this scan.

refused.item: Rendering any sentence that implies user-owned, connected, current or factual data
refused.reason: No authority-issued source exists in this journey, so the schema's bound arm is unreachable, and disclosed-demo would still put a data-shaped sentence in front of the reader with nothing behind it. The honest shape is withheldClaims, and that is where those sentences live.
